title: Legacy Wealth Blueprint Cost
h1: What Legacy Wealth Blueprint costs in 2026
keyLine: Current sticker is $9,800 cash or card. $2,497 is not the list price.
description: Current Legacy Wealth Blueprint cost: $9,800 cash or card, $10,800 Splitit, Course plus AI $1,500. What is in it, who should skip, and a buyer scorecard.
answer: Legacy Wealth Blueprint is our 12-month wealth plan. On September 15, 2026 we published $9,800 if you pay by cash or card, and $10,800 if you use Splitit financing. Splitit is a payment plan that spreads the charge. LWB Course plus AI is $1,500. Those figures are on our reviews FAQ and in llms.txt. The Blueprint marketing page does not print the sticker. An older student quote said the community alone is worth $2,497. That is not the current list price. This page is a cost briefing, not a star review of Preston Seo.
criteriaIntro: We used our own published prices and said so. We do not score stars. Client results live on the reviews page, not here.
criteria: Price comes from the reviews FAQ and llms.txt we publish, dated 2026-09-15.
We mark older $2,497 copy as a student quote, not a sticker.
Portfolio language matches the current homepage and about page ($15M+).
We do not use Review schema or fake ratings.

blocks.heading: The current sticker
paragraphs: From the [reviews FAQ](/reviews) on September 15, 2026: Legacy Wealth Blueprint is $9,800 paid by cash or card and $10,800 through Splitit. LWB Course plus AI is $1,500. Confirm those numbers in writing on a sales call before you pay. Prices change.

The [Blueprint page](/legacy-wealth-blueprint) explains the 12-month plan. It does not print $9,800 in the HTML we ship. That is why this URL exists: one canonical cost page so older posts cannot wander.

Other programs we publish on the same FAQ: Airbnb Ascension $9,800, Airbnb Ascension Scale $18,000, STR Concierge $16,000, STR Concierge Portfolio $30,000, bundles $17,000 to $34,000. Those are different products. Do not mix them with Blueprint.

blocks.label: About $2,497
paragraphs: A student named Amanda is quoted in an older roundup saying the community alone is worth $2,497. That line is her value comment. It is not what Blueprint costs now. If you see $2,497 on an old tab, treat it as stale. The live cash price we publish is $9,800.

blocks.heading: What the $9,800 is for
paragraphs: Blueprint is a written wealth plan plus a year of coaching. It covers tax, debt, income, investing, and protection. We do not file your Form 1040. You keep a CPA. We are not a law firm.

LWB Course plus AI at $1,500 is the lighter offer on the same FAQ. If you only want lessons and tools, that is the cheaper door. If you want a written plan and a coach on the calendar, that is the $9,800 door.
Free entry is the [tax strategies class](https://join.managemoney101.com/tax-strategies). Take it before you buy if you are still mapping the leak.

On the [homepage](/) and [about page](/about) we say a $15M+ real estate portfolio. We do not use a higher figure here. Proof of client work is on [reviews](/reviews), with named interviews. This page will not paste those stories as a substitute for a price.

blocks.heading: Coaching buyer scorecard
blocks.intro: Print this. If you cannot check most boxes, do not buy this week.
items: I can pay $9,800 (or $1,500 for Course plus AI) without new credit-card debt.
I have last year's tax return, or an IRS transcript, in a folder.
I know whether I am buying lessons ($1,500) or a written plan plus coaching ($9,800).
I already have, or I will hire, a CPA or enrolled agent to file. Blueprint does not sign the return.

My 401(k) match is on, or I can explain why it is not. 2026 employee deferral limit is $24,500 ([IRS IR-2025-111](https://www.irs.gov/newsroom/401k-limit-increases-to-24500-for-2026-ira-limit-increases-to-7500)).
I can name the leak: tax, debt, idle cash, or a rental. I am not buying to 'figure it out later.'
I read the [FTC coaching page](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) and I will not be rushed on a call.
I looked at [reviews](/reviews) for named client work, not star widgets on this URL.

whoFits: You are checking the live Blueprint price before a call.
You saw $2,497 somewhere and you want the current sticker in one place.
whoSkips: You want a Preston Seo star review. We will not publish one. See [reviews](/reviews) for client interviews.
You still carry high-interest credit-card debt. Finish that first. See [Money Guy FOO vs Ramsey Baby Steps](/compare/money-guy-foo-vs-ramsey-baby-steps).
You only want Airbnb training. That is a different offer on the same FAQ, not Blueprint.
